Overall is positive $467.51. The first S2K post covered the handwritten grid on scan pages 1–2 and rows 106–107 (74 lines). Crown Blue 100, Winston margin lines, and a few ambiguous margin names were skipped because they do not map cleanly to one sheet row. Those 100 lines now have quantity on hand equal to the physical count.
